chapter_title: Concerning the Three Blows that befell the Enemy b

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
The very principle of denial that opposes the Divine has been struck by a complete series of defeats through a full course of spiritual combat, and in each stage it has met more severe peril from wisdom and its power.

First, it was drawn out from concealed and hardened falsity into a state of open spiritual exposure, and it was cut off from the ultimate ground in which its denial had rooted itself. In that first combat it was overcome, restrained, and held fast by the living reception of good and truth.

Second comes the state when its coherence is undone: its hardened persuasions are loosened, its fixed form is dispersed, and it perishes by the consuming presence of pure love that cannot be borne by self-love. It is ruined and cast down because the fabricated appearances that once supported its seeming life are taken away. Then it is drawn together into a lasting restraint that matches its own inmost pattern, and it is reduced to the same powerless condition it had at its first emergence.

Third comes the final reversal at completion, when every element is discriminated and set in order, and what is active and ruling in evil is separated from what is receptive and fostering within it. Then the ruling falsity is confined in a hardened, undivided compulsion, while the receptive element is shut up in utter spiritual death. Between them an unremovable separation is fixed, an immutable barrier established in the midst, through successive states without end.

In this way the perpetual restraint of that resisting principle is effected: by a confinement heavy with its own evil and made firm by Divine order, from which there is no release, because its restraint is fully accomplished and confirmed to eternity. Its removal from all mingling with what is good is likewise fully accomplished, and that separation stands to eternity.

paragraph_translations.notes: Clean; the doubling of ‘three blows/three wars’ reads as emphasis on completeness and progression.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Strong coherence as a single, escalating spiritual sequence: exposure and restraint, dissolution under higher love and loss of appearances, then final discrimination and irreversible separation, concluding with perpetual confinement. The only points that resist are the gendered division and the specific ‘stone’ image, but they translate consistently as an active/receptive split within evil and an immutable barrier of fixed order.

findings.diagnosis: Clean opening in correspondential teaching: sets a three-stage process of defeat with escalating intensity. No intrusive jurisdictions, lists, or rank-language; the chapter’s story is a single functional narrative about what happens to the Enemy across three wars.
findings.evidence: Text: “received three bad blows with three wars; and worse dangers from the Light in those three wars.” The spiritual reading reports: “Clean; … emphasis on completeness and progression.” The sense arises from the function of ‘wars/blows’ as stages in a process (exposure → dissolution → final separation), not from named administrators or territorial governance.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: the first ‘blow’ is described as extraction, separation, defeat, and binding—an ordered sequence of actions. The only potential snag (‘middle’, ‘living soul’) is semantic/technical, not a voice shift or narrative seam.
findings.evidence: Text: “brought out to the middle and separated… vanquished… caught and [bound] by the living soul.” The spiritual reading notes difficulty only in rendering “middle” and “living soul,” but it does not report narrative breakage. Nothing administrative appears (no officials, watches, camps, authority chains). Functionally coherent: removal from dark ground → restraint by a living agent.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate: deepening of the process via dissolution/melting, destruction of sustaining ‘images,’ then re-collection into a fitting fetter “corresponding to his archetype.” This is still teaching by inner mechanics (how evil loses coherence) rather than governance.
findings.evidence: Text: “dissolved and melted… perishes in this great fire… destroyed… from the images… gathered in [to the] fetter corresponding to his archetype.” The spiritual reading: “overall coherent… ‘images’… ‘archetype’ as inmost pattern.” The narrative continues seamlessly from ¶2 (binding) into a more ultimate mode of binding (reduction to origin-condition). No inserted inventories or titles.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty inside the same correspondential narrative: gendered terms (‘male/female’), ‘lump/tomb,’ and especially the clause about “stone in their midst” are abrupt images, but they still serve the chapter’s functional telos (final separation and irreversible confinement). The spiritual reading “stumbled” only at the level of correspondential mapping, not because an administrative overlay intruded.
findings.evidence: Text: “everything will be separated, and male will be divided [from] female… male will be bound in the lump… female… thrown in to the tomb… … stone in their midst, for generation upon generation.” The reading explicitly flags the resistance: “The only points that resist are the gendered division and the specific ‘stone’ image.” However, the passage does not switch into governance vocabulary; it remains action/result-focused (separate/divide/bound/thrown/fixed barrier). Removing it would collapse the promised ‘third blow’ and break ¶1’s threefold structure, so it is not a likely insertion seam.

findings.diagnosis: Clean concluding seal in correspondential voice: recapitulates the effect (“binding… set apart… for ever”) without introducing new actors or administrative taxonomy. Repetition functions as closure, not as a systematizing addendum in a different voice.
findings.evidence: Text: “binding… in a fetter… never escape… bound him for ever… achieved his being set apart… set apart for ever.” The spiritual reading reads this as “concluding and sealing” and does not report a discontinuity. The chapter’s narrative (three blows → permanent fetter/separation) resolves smoothly.

textual_criticism.summary: No administrative-layer intrusions detected. The chapter is consistently in a correspondential/process voice (what happens to the Enemy across three stages). The spiritual reading’s only ‘stumbles’ (¶4: male/female; stone) are best diagnosed as genuine symbolic/lexical difficulty within the substrate, not as insertions or overlays. Recommendations: excise 0, annotate 0, none 5.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: The Darkness itself, the Enemy, has received three bad blows with three wars; and worse dangers from the Light in those three wars.
The first: (The enemy) was brought out to the middle and separated from his dark earth, whence he had departed. He was vanquished in that first war, caught and [bound] by the living soul.

The second blow is the time when he will be dissolved and melted, and he perishes in this great fire. He is destroyed and overthrown, from the images that are all by which he exists. And he will be gathered in [to the] fetter corresponding to his archetype, and be made like he was from the first beginning.

The third blow that will befall the Enemy is the 'rolling back' [at the] end when everything will be separated, and male will be divided [from] female. Now, the male will be bound in the lump, but the female [will be thrown] in to the tomb. For it will be divided [and be divided apart, and be set apart] stone in their midst, for generation upon generation, for ever and ever.

⟨p.106⟩ This is the way that the binding of the enemy will come about, in a fetter that is burdensome and strong, one from which there is never escape; because [they have achieved] his binding and bound him for ever. And they have achieved his being set apart, and he has been set apart for ever.
